title: Machine learning and experiments implicate IER3 in airway inflammation in COPD
summary: Interpretable machine-learning models (support vector machine) classified COPD status in CHARLS with validation across survey waves, and independent lung transcriptomic analyses combined differential expression, co-expression networks, 113 machine-learning configurations and single-cell profiling to nominate IER3. Two-sample Mendelian randomization, AAV-mediated IER3 silencing in cigarette-smoke-exposed mice and siRNA knockdown in bronchial epithelial cells are reported to show that IER3 promotes airway epithelial inflammation. Drug screening and molecular simulations prioritized candidate compounds. Machine learning is one of several analyses and the abstract was truncated in the reviewed material.
